headline: Indian tech tycoon bets $30M of his own money to build AI alternative to Microsoft Office
snapshot: Neo is Bhavin Turakhia's fifth venture and his latest involving enterprise software. This time he's taking on Microsoft Office, Google Apps with AI. The competitive question is whether this changes the model race, enterprise integrations or customer lock-in as major AI providers battle for durable platform advantage.

live_newsroom.headline: Trump drops restrictions on Anthropic's Mythos and Fable models
